newsitem.title: CHINA: Italy's Pirelli plans China tyre venture.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Pirelli plans China tyre venture.

text.p: Italian tyre and cable group Pirelli SPA plans to set up a radial tyre joint venture in China's northeastern province of Jilin, the Xinhua news agency said on Monday.
The new venture with the Changchun Tyre Factory would produce 1.5 million radial tyres a year, Xinhua said.

The tyre and cable giant was in the final stage of talks with officials of Changchun, capital of Jilin province, and results would be announced in December, the agency said. It gave no further details.
China's largest automobile manufacturer, the Number One Automobile Group Co, is based in Changchun, it said.
